title: WIRE FACE demo for threejs - Game dev tool for talking characters
author: SpearHammer
selftext:
I've been working on wire face for over a year. Someone said I should make it work for threejs so here it is.  I've never seen anything quite like it so i'd love your feedback

Wire face instanly brings any facial image to life with an emotive, talking face with lip sync functionality.  
  
It works on noth 2D images and 2D images. Photos, Cartoons, Illustrations - if it has a face then wire face can detect it and bring it to life instantly.  If it doesnt have a face, wireface can create the wireframe and position it on your head, giving your models a 3d face as shown in the video.

The faces have expressions - blinking, winking, brow raise, pout, smile, smirk, etc.  
They have moods - happy, sad, fear, suprise, thinking, sleeping, tired etc.

You can connect them to any TTS or AI to make them talk too.

Play the theatre demo here  
[https://wireface.dev/threejs/demo/](https://wireface.dev/threejs/demo/)
